description: ODBC-LOAD and ODBC-DIAG through ADODB and the MSDASQL provider, using connection strings that need no database path: (a) the Access driver with no Dbq, (b) the Access driver with a Dbq in a folder that does not exist, (c) the legacy driver name '(*.mdb)' with such a Dbq, (d) a driver name that is not installed, (e) a DSN that does not exist, (f) the Access driver with no Provider key, and (g) the same driver in Extended Properties. For each: Provider after assignment, Open outcome, State, loaded modules after Open, the properties Provider Name, Provider Friendly Name, DBMS Name and DBMS Version and every Errors entry (Number, Description, Source, SQLState, NativeError). Asks the Driver Manager and driver identities reached, the diagnostics returned and any modules loaded; success against a real database is deferred because the probe cannot build a path.
retentionNote: Designed r-oledb-odbc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
